fusions.name: Brute Load
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Siege Round
fusions.desc: Fires a shell that deals 40 damage and bursts for 80% of it on every enemy within 3.5 tiles of the target.

fusions.name: Heavy Charge
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Recoil Dividend
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
